style: Warm, clear American English product narration. Confident, thoughtful and conversational; brisk natural pacing, about 165 words per minute. Natural emphasis on the consequence of each action. No sales voice and no theatrical pauses. Speak only the exact transcript.
segments: A client chooses this jacket. A similar jacket is not the same choice. How do you keep that decision connected to the item that gets packed?
ClosetRelay connects a client's choice to one physical item. Here, fictional appointments use the working local application. Record the selected navy jacket, then place an exclusive hold.
Update the item's condition before packing, and the old approval and hold no longer apply. Review the changed record and approve it again. An old decision cannot silently carry forward.
Let's scan the other jacket. The server rejects it. The correct jacket stays held, and nothing is marked packed.
Scan the exact item instead. One packing handoff is recorded. Reloading preserves it, and another appointment cannot approve the packed item.
The YouCam preview panel is designed to bind an image to that same item and consent revision. Live YouCam is not connected here; this video claims no generated result.
This is one local operator workflow. Separate client logins, real provider validation, and comparison with existing styling tools are still required.
ClosetRelay. The chosen item. The held item. The packed item. One continuous record.
